# ∞/dx — Horizon and Differential

## #0 — The lived where opens

A true account can make this circumstance more exact without exhausting what can appear within it. In [the personed relation](AM-IS.md), the one who lives and what can be said meet through an encounter. That encounter opens a horizon. Its present determination is real, and further determination remains possible through the very field in which it is real.

`∞/dx` gives this relation its sign. **∞** names the unbounded depth no finite mark contains. **dx** names the local differential through which change can become exact. The slash holds local precision in relation to inexhaustible depth: a finite difference can run true without becoming a numerical measure of the whole horizon that makes further difference possible.

## #1 — The instance becomes a difference

At [X/x](X-x.md), the particular *x* makes determining capacity legible and can recur as another instance. The passage to *dx* asks what changes locally through that recurrence. An instance can now be read in its difference from another, with a precision that depends on the relation being measured.

The [Binary Explication](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md), File 1 §5, sources this move from instance to differential. The finite appearance gives the field a local face. Its truth belongs to the relation it makes available, while its finitude belongs to how much that appearance can articulate. These two determinations coexist: partial expression can carry exact knowledge.

The whole is present in the way the local determination runs true to it. A claim that the whole were stored inside one part as a recoverable object would change the operation: it would ask local precision to supply exhaustive possession.

## #2 — What differentiation does not recover

The relation becomes exact in the calculus development preserved by Core Theorems — Pithy. Differentiating a function removes an additive constant. For example,

$$
F(x)=x^2+7 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad F'(x)=2x.
$$

The derivative is exact. Integrating it gives a family:

$$
\int 2x\,dx=x^2+C.
$$

The local change does not select the original `7` from the possible constants. A further condition, such as the value of the function at a specified point, is needed to do that. This limitation belongs to the information carried by the derivative, not to a defective calculation.

This [worked mathematical relation](matheme/formal-neighbours/README.md) distinguishes exactness from provenance: knowing a determination truly does not entail knowing every condition of its derivation. The [difference between an account and its present accounting condition](../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) has a wider argued office. The mathematical loss of an additive constant is one precise operation; it does not by itself establish every philosophical instance of non-enclosure.

## #3 — The finite faces the unbounded

File 1's poem gives this determination the line “Silent but in structure reverential.” The mark has carried conscious circumstance, question, force, pattern, and person. At **#5, Realisation**, it recognises how those determinations give a face to what no single articulation contains.

Silence here retains the articulation. A person can give an exact answer and recognise the depth in which the answer remains situated. Reverence names the relation of that precision to its horizon: the mark faces what it cannot possess. It can therefore be definite without making its definiteness the limit of the real.

This is the final interior determination because horizon cannot simply remain one further object inside the list. To make “the unbounded” a completed item would repeat the attempted enclosure at a more abstract level. The achieved sequence has to return through the relation that made its determinations possible.

## #4 — Two folds through the same horizon

`∞/dx` joins `AM/IS` in the **Knowing/unKnowing harmonic**. Knowledge is personed and situated; its continuing answerability opens the horizon no situated statement exhausts. Across the sequence it joins `0/1` as **Essence, 0+5**. Conscious circumstance at the opening and differential horizon at the close are one openness encountered before and after determination.

The two folds have distinct work. The harmonic follows knowing into recognition of its limit. The complementary fold lets the final determination recognise the ground present from the beginning. Neither makes the sixfold a serial ladder whose later steps replace its earlier conditions.

The folds retain their distinct work within [the whole traversal](../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md). [Octave return](matheme/music/README.md) retains difference in another exact form: the ratio kernel reaches octave return through the `9/8` interval by which `16/9` falls short of `2/1`. That interval and the calculus constant have different mathematical objects and operations. Their declared relation concerns return retaining a difference which completion has not erased.

## #5→0 — The achieved mark turns

[1/0](1-0.md) returns this achieved determination towards its condition. The return does not add a seventh interior position. It changes the direction of the relation: the mark that has become exact turns towards the ground it cannot make into another mark.

[Local exactness and its unbounded horizon](../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/25-s3-p0-eight-determinations.md) remain together when [the traversal turns back into `0/1`](eight-determinations.md). The opening conscious circumstance can now be recognised through what the traversal has made available. Local exactness survives that return; its horizon remains open.
